findings.detail: The extracted fair-value sum exceeds the schedule/companyfacts total by 308,170 thousand, matching the subtotal row Total Non-Controlled/Affiliate Company Investments.

rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation shows the source schedule total and companyfacts anchor are 5,819,755 thousand, while the extracted holdings fair-value sum is 6,127,925 thousand. The 308,170 thousand overshoot exactly matches the fair value on the subtotal row Total Non-Controlled/Affiliate Company Investments, which is already included in TOTAL INVESTMENTS and should not be counted as a position.
